thread:
Alex T.: TIGER canary rollout scheduled for 22:00 UTC today. Rolling to 1% -> 10% over 30m. Need final ack: smoke owner, rollback owner, DB guard, and canary watchers. Ping if you can't make it.

Samir: I can run smoke tests and watch metrics. What's the smoke script? :thumbsup:

Alex T.: Smoke script is below, run from infra bastion:
```bash
ssh infra@bastion
./scripts/smoke_run.sh --canary tiger --checks health,kps,latency
```
Also check /ops/metrics/tiger-canary for spike charts.

Jordan: I'll be rollback owner. Rollback tag: release/v1.12.3-rollback. I'll prepare the job and keep it paused until needed.

Priya K.: DB guard here — I'll monitor migrations + schema locks. FYI no DB migrations in this deploy, just config + model swap.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled by Alex T. at 22:00 UTC. Canary policy: initial 1% for 10m, auto-increase to 5% on pass, to 10% on manual ack.

Samir: Got it. I'll run smoke at T+2m and post results.

Jordan: Do we need cache warm before traffic? Last time we saw 5-10% latency spike.

Alex T.: Yes, run the prewarm:
```bash
./tools/prewarm_cache.sh --model tiger --concurrency 8
```
Do that at T-10m.

Priya K.: Keys/credentials ok — KMS rotations completed this morning.

Samir: Smoke run results: all checks passed, qps steady, p95 latency 120ms. :thumbsup:

Alex T.: Thanks. Acks: Alex T., Samir, Jordan, Priya K. We're green to proceed. I'll trigger the window at 22:00. If any abort, post here and call Jordan.
